text: Japan's October core inflation rose to 2.2%, its highest in 2026, while headline inflation reached 2.3%. Following September's energy subsidy expiry, energy prices rose 2.2% and gas prices 5.8%. Core-core inflation declined from 2.4% to 2.2%.

meta.note: Reported December subsidy reinstatement and anticipated monetary tightening are not realized policy changes.

text: Anthropic's underwriters exercised the full 147 million-share overallotment, bringing IPO proceeds to $93.5 billion. A concurrent $26 billion private placement brought aggregate gross proceeds to $119.5 billion. Shares declined 12% in Friday premarket trading.

meta.note: Aggregate gross proceeds include the private placement and exclude offering expenses.

text: Anthropic shares fell 8.5% in Friday trading following its Nasdaq debut. Nvidia and AMD each declined more than 13%, while Amazon, Google and Microsoft also closed lower. Analyst ratings on Anthropic diverged between neutral and outperform.

meta.note: Equity valuation contraction is distinct from realized operational contraction or withdrawal of IPO capital.

text: Trump announced proposed restrictions and tax penalties on U.S. companies building data centers abroad. Major cloud providers maintain international infrastructure networks, while 64% of surveyed registered voters oppose AI data centers within 10 miles of their homes.

meta.note: No formal policy instrument, tax rate, legal mechanism or implementation timeline was specified.

text: Trump publicly reaffirmed confidence in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick amid bipartisan and intra-administration pressure. Sen. Tom Cotton raised the timing of a potential replacement relative to the incoming Democratic Senate majority. Trump cited Lutnick's involvement in the U.S. Intel stake.

meta.note: Presidential support remains explicit; no personnel change or replacement nomination was announced.

text: Nvidia shares fell 14% Friday, completing seven consecutive losing weeks, the longest streak since 2008. Shares declined 46% over the period, erasing $2.6 trillion in market value despite above-estimate earnings and increased revenue guidance. The SEC is reportedly exploring accounting issues.

meta.note: Reported SEC scrutiny does not establish accounting violations; valuation losses remain distinct from operating performance.

text: CrowdStrike is reportedly in acquisition talks with Zscaler. Zscaler shares rose 18% in extended trading, while CrowdStrike fell more than 8%. Their respective market capitalizations before the reported talks were approximately $32 billion and $235 billion.

meta.note: Concentration remains contingent; no definitive acquisition agreement or transaction terms have been disclosed.
